admission.justification: The test catches a landing target incorrectly attributed to the repository default branch.

applicability: Landing projections for a contract with distinct work and source branches.
conditions: The work branch supplies the remote-work probe and PR-head lookup.
The target uses an observed PR base when present, otherwise the supplied contract source branch, otherwise main.
Unobserved rows retain named contract branch labels without claiming the remote was observed.
exclusions: These row facts are observations and do not admit publication, cleanup or abandonment.
